name: aureon.defender 0.5.1
body: Windows 0.5.1: scans run in the 24/7 engine and repeat every 3 days, every media branch and content credential stripped automatically, lossless PNG savings, hidden screen capture blocked, network guard for public wi-fi, autopilot removal, silent memory with ransomware undo. Android 0.5.1 follows once its signing key is configured for automated builds; Android 0.4.6 stays available.

name: aureon.defender 0.4.6 — Windows and Android
body:
Windows and Android 0.4.6, built from the tagged source on a Windows laptop.

Includes the current main-branch quiet mode, confirmed-threat removal, trash/device-trace cleanup, drain reporting and metadata changes. Android retains the 0.4.3 signing identity (versionCode 9). Windows setup now handles both ZIP directory separator formats.

Verification: 163 Windows tests run (155 passed, 8 skipped), 54 core tests passed, 3 portable tests passed, 12 Android rule/file-check assertions passed. APK alignment/signature and matching signer certificate verified. Windows embedded setup payload extracted and verified; extracted executable --help passed. A phone was not connected during this build, so no new on-device test or installation is claimed.

These packages were built locally and uploaded to GitHub. GitHub-hosted builds are blocked before execution by an account billing lock. The repository now includes the Windows/Android release workflow and encrypted Android signing secrets for future hosted builds once that account issue is resolved.

Windows publisher is unsigned. Verify SHA256SUMS.txt. Downloading does not install either application automatically.

name: aureon.defender 0.4.4 — Windows workflow and responsive UI
body:
Windows update: responsive dashboard cards and controls; sidebar search; detailed skipped-file diagnostics; explicit Recycle Bin exclusions; automatic reversible quarantine for confirmed threats inside the current user profile when enabled; per-user metadata-copy automation without a machine-wide settings prompt. Uncertain matches stay visible for review. No automatic permanent deletion. Windows UAC and filesystem access checks remain enforced.

113 Windows tests passed. 135 dashboard tab/viewport combinations checked; no tested controls escaped their cards. Setup payload extraction verified.

This release updates Windows only. Android APK remains v0.4.3; macOS/Linux/Pi source preview and limited iOS/ChromeOS web edition remain available in earlier releases. Native cross-platform feature parity is not claimed. Publisher remains unsigned.

name: Signal 0.4.3 — clearer downloads, scan review and your interface
body:
aureon.defender Signal 0.4.3 — direct downloads, no app stores.

New: ink/lime full-artwork icons, borderless full-name header, original Signal footer, themed scrollbars, site-local direct download controls, adaptive Android hardware/app inventory, available desktop sensor readings and a worldwide compatibility explorer: https://aureon-defender.vercel.app/compatibility.html . The map has 249 country/territory references and 16 device families; it is not per-country certification or an installed-device census.

Landing page and installable web tools: https://aureon-defender.vercel.app/

Windows: read-only full accessible fixed-drive scan, progress/cancel, reviewed findings and quarantine; previewed Fix all for supported reversible per-user privacy settings; original-preserving metadata copies and visible failures; battery precision/source and observed upload/download traffic; dock placement and app cursor styles; optional separately installed ClamAV scanner (disabled by default).

Android 12+: granted-folder SHA-256 checks against an imported list, JPEG/PNG metadata-clean PNG copies with orientation preserved, defined battery and observed traffic readings, bottom/left/right/automatic tablet docks, app-scoped external-mouse pointer styles, larger dock labels and Signal/Frost/Copper appearance. New adaptive icon has a full dark artwork background.

Platforms do not have identical OS privileges. Android folder checking is not Windows Defender or a full-system antivirus; the web edition provides selected-file hashes and report reading only. Metadata removal does not remove all fingerprints, visible content, steganography, watermarks or previously shared copies. Originals are kept by the new cleanup workflows. Bulk privacy fixes leave admin/manual items visible. No automatic permanent deletion is introduced.

Mac/Linux native builds remain unavailable because GitHub's account billing lock blocked hosted jobs before execution. A limited Python source preview is attached. Pi discovery is not proof of enforcement. Research and capability matrix: https://github.com/shep95/aureon.defender/blob/main/docs/DEFENSIVE-INTEGRATIONS-AND-CUSTOMIZATION.md

Verification: expanded Windows suite 111 passed; packaged inert-file scan returned expected review exit code 3; UI integrity matched. Dashboard: 45 tab/width checks plus 60 dock/width/tab checks. Android: 10 rule/file assertions and 35 Pixel assertions including dock choices and oriented metadata-clean output. Landing: 17 viewports, enlarged text, OS recommendations, release update notice, untrusted notes rendering, API failure fallback and offline reload. These are not every-device or multi-day endurance guarantees. Safari/iPhone rendering was not tested.

Unsigned Windows publisher. Verify SHA256SUMS.txt and review OS prompts. No signing keys, credentials or personal runtime data are included. No App Store, Google Play or Microsoft Store is required. Updates are manually installed; the landing page shows public release changes.


### Setup and browser companion
A single-file Windows Setup EXE is now attached. Open it after download and approve the normal OS prompt; no manual ZIP extraction. Its embedded-payload extraction test passed; the new wrapper was not machine-installed on this laptop. Publisher remains unsigned. The portable ZIP remains available.

noah.shield original ZIP and manifest-adapted Chromium ZIP are attached. The adapted extension background worker/popup loaded in an isolated Chromium profile with no popup JS errors; this is not a complete feature audit. Browser-specific installation instructions are on the landing page; permanent Firefox/Safari/mobile packages are not supplied.

name: Signal — direct Windows / Android downloads and platform previews
body:
Direct downloads, no app stores. Source and platform scope are in the repository README.

- Windows x64 0.4.0: tested Windows engine and Signal dashboard. Extract the full ZIP. Unsigned publisher.
- Android 0.4.1 APK: native local monitor and floating navigation. Android 12+; OS background limits apply.
- iPhone/iPad: https://shep95.github.io/aureon.defender/ — Safari > Share > Add to Home Screen. This is a web edition, not a native IPA or system antivirus. The web-edition ZIP is for HTTPS self-hosting.
- macOS/Linux: any attached native packages are limited portable PREVIEWS. They do not contain the full Windows engine. Native CI tests and packaged-executable smoke checks run before upload. Mac packages are not Developer ID signed or notarized; Linux compatibility depends on distribution/architecture.
- Portable Python source is also attached. No country geofence is implemented; worldwide OS/network/store-independent availability is not guaranteed.

Verification: Windows 101 tests (1 phone test skipped), 15 live dashboard pages and 45 responsive page checks; Android 10 rule/file assertions and 19 Pixel checks; web known-answer hashing, invalid imports, report text rendering and offline-cache reload. No multi-day endurance or every-device guarantee. Check SHA256SUMS.txt; each CI-built preview has its own .sha256 file.

No API keys, signing keys, personal runtime histories or passwords are included. Third-party notices remain applicable. Three Windows abuse.ch feeds need a user-provided API key. This release grants no new platform privileges or patent clearance.


## Current distribution status
Windows and Android downloads are attached and verified. Store-free iPhone/iPad web edition: https://aureon-defender.vercel.app/ (Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen; local file/hash and report tools only, not a native IPA or background antivirus).

Native Mac/Linux packages are **not available**: GitHub stopped every hosted build before execution because the account is locked due to a billing issue. The portable source preview and build workflow are included; no native build/test success is claimed.
